reviewed_behavior: Untouched region/scene headers open for current physical zone and close after leaving.
Only an actual mouse or keyboard toggle creates a manual preference.
Clipped headers do not record false as a manual close.
Manual open/closed choices persist during the running game session, including Finder reopen and refresh.
A manually opened displayed child keeps its otherwise automatic parent open.
An explicit manual parent close wins over automatic expansion.
Stable area/scene/instance keys survive count/name/filter and singleton-heading changes.
Skipped singleton headers do not leave pending SetNextItemOpen state for another widget.
Descriptive labels, room/door number toggle, singleton-heading behavior and dropdown body are byte-identical to the previously reviewed dropdown snapshot.
